preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit the vulnerability
Contract must have accumulated BossBaby tokens from fees (balanceOf(address(this)) >= swapTokensAtAmount)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call claimStuckTokens(address(0x0)) to drain all BNB from the contract. The vulnerability is that liquidity fees are set to 0, but the contract still accumulates BNB from marketing fees and potentially from other sources. The owner can claim this BNB since the claimStuckTokens function allows the owner to withdraw any token including native BNB (address(0x0)).
